title: Q-AUDIT-dg-visibility: fm-declared-live-drift failing (fail): The tick's repo-visibility loop sets it back; if it reports refused, give the administration app access to that repository.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe dg-visibility
**Status:** closed

Failure mode `fm-declared-live-drift` detected by `dg-visibility`, failing since 2026-11-25T21:07:20Z.
Evidence: x ultrastable/seed: unreadable to this token; a private repository or a missing one (HTTP 404), declared public

Signature: c12868ece903 (disposition: fix).
Suspected root cause: a repository's live visibility differs from org/repos.json or doctrine/tenant-repos.json
Remedy: The tick's repo-visibility loop sets it back; if it reports refused, give the administration app access to that repository.
Fix the earliest cause, so the detector passes; do not weaken or remove the detector.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe dg-visibility

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T03:14:49Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
